# KinesisFlow

> KinesisFlow is an AI-assisted video creation product for documentary-style and Kids & Family videos.

## Public pages

- Home and production studio: /
- Creator blog and SEO guides: /blog
- About the platform: /about
- Frequently asked questions: /faq
- Terms and Conditions: /terms
- Privacy Policy: /privacy

## Core capabilities

- Generate scene-based scripts from a topic or custom narration.
- Choose cinematic documentary direction or Kids & Family formats: learning, entertainment, gentle adventure, bedtime, and animated rhyme.
- Generate audience-aware visuals and independent documentary/kids narration profiles.
- Select whether synchronized subtitles are burned into the final video.
- Review scenes, replace images, edit narration, adjust timing, and rerender.
- Credits are reserved during processing and deducted after a validated successful render.
- One-minute projects support landscape 16:9 or vertical 9:16; longer projects currently use landscape.

## Supported narration providers

- Microsoft Neural voices
- Sarvam AI Bulbul voices
- OpenRouter speech models
- Cloudflare speech providers

## Showcase formats

- Landscape 16:9
- Instagram Reels 9:16
- TikTok 9:16

## Access notes

- Public documentation pages may be indexed.
- Admin, authentication, generated user media, and API routes are private or operational surfaces.

## Limitations

- Generated scripts, claims, visuals, narration, and subtitles may contain errors or inconsistencies.
- KinesisFlow does not guarantee factual accuracy, uniqueness, rights clearance, or child suitability.
- Creators must review factual claims, intellectual-property rights, age appropriateness, pronunciation, and final output before publishing.
- Availability and output quality depend on configured third-party AI, storage, authentication, and payment providers.
